prompt: How many versions of the .NET platform have been released that have a support lifetime of more than 12 months?
answer:
**12 versions.**

The listed .NET/.NET Core versions with support lifetimes longer than 12 months are all except **.NET Core 3.0**, which was supported from September 23, 2019, to March 3, 2020—less than a year.
